name: benchmark
description: Gold-set scoring for row-oriented extraction pipelines. Scores one row-oriented candidate relation (CSV, JSON, JSONL or Parquet) against a human-validated JSONL assertion set and emits a deterministic benchmark.v0 score report with a derived quality band for downstream policy.

invocation.output_mode: human text by default; benchmark.v0 JSON with --json; one-line summary or TSV with --render

arguments.name: candidate
arguments.description: Candidate relation to score (CSV, JSON, JSONL or Parquet)

options.name: assertions
options.description: Human-validated assertion file (JSONL). Frozen input: the cache key is (candidate bytes, assertion bytes, key columns/profile).

options.name: key
options.description: One key column or a comma-separated composite key used to look up each assertion entity; conflicts with --profile

options.name: profile
options.description: Frozen JSON profile containing a key or key_columns string array; conflicts with --key

options.name: explicit
options.description: Opt in to raw expected and actual cell values in failure output; default reports emit opaque sha256 hashes

options.name: lock
options.description: Verify the candidate is a member of these lock.v0 lockfiles before scoring; supports sha256: and blake3: bytes_hash values

options.name: json
options.description: Emit the machine-readable benchmark.v0 JSON report

options.name: render
options.description: Emit a one-line summary or a TSV header and row instead of the full report (conflicts with --json)

options.name: describe
options.description: Print this operator manifest (identical to `capabilities --json`) and exit 0

options.name: schema
options.description: Print the JSON Schema for benchmark.v0 stdout (score report or refusal envelope) and exit 0

options.name: no_witness
options.description: Do not record this run in the ambient witness ledger

options.name: robot_triage
options.description: Deprecated alias of `doctor triage --json`: emit compact read-only triage JSON

options.name: version
options.description: Print the benchmark version and exit 0

commands.name: capabilities
commands.description: Emit this machine-readable contract (same document as --describe).

commands.name: robot-docs
commands.description: Print the agent-oriented command guide (`robot-docs guide`).

commands.name: doctor
commands.description: Read-only cmdrvl.doctor.v1 report: crate identity, report contract and side-effect boundaries. `doctor --json` is health; `doctor capabilities --json` embeds this contract; `doctor triage --json` adds next_actions. Exit 0 healthy, 1 unhealthy, 2 usage error. Never reads candidates, assertions, lockfiles or the witness ledger. Deprecated aliases: `doctor health`, `doctor --robot-triage` (= triage).

commands.name: witness
commands.description: Query the ambient witness ledger: `witness query [--tool T] [--since TS] [--until TS] [--outcome PASS|FAIL|REFUSAL] [--input-hash H] [--limit N]`, `witness last`, `witness count [same filters]`. An empty result exits 0 and prints [] (count prints {"count":0}).

0.meaning: PASS: every assertion passed; or a read-only metadata command succeeded

1.meaning: FAIL: one or more assertions failed or were skipped (doctor: unhealthy)

2.meaning: REFUSAL, CLI usage error, or unexpected top-level error

refusals.message: Candidate, assertions or lockfile could not be read
refusals.action: fix the path or permissions and rerun

refusals.message: Assertions JSONL is malformed or semantically invalid
refusals.action: fix the assertion file and rerun

refusals.message: Assertions file contains zero valid assertions
Candidate does not contain the requested key column
refusals.action: pass existing columns to --key or fix the profile
canonicalize the candidate or choose a unique key

refusals.message: Candidate key values include null or blank values
Candidate format is unsupported or is not one row-oriented relation
refusals.action: supply CSV, JSON, JSONL or Parquet with one row per record

refusals.message: Candidate is not present in the supplied lockfiles
refusals.action: pass the correct --lock or lock the candidate first

refusals.message: Candidate hash does not match the lock member
refusals.action: use the locked file or regenerate the lock

refusals.message: Lock member uses an unsupported bytes_hash algorithm prefix
refusals.action: regenerate the lock with sha256 or blake3

refusals.message: Profile is unreadable, malformed, or does not define a valid key array

env_vars.name: SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH
env_vars.description: Unix seconds used for witness record timestamps instead of the wall clock

env_vars.name: CLICOLOR_FORCE
env_vars.description: Force ANSI status styling when NO_COLOR and TERM=dumb do not disable it

env_vars.name: BENCHMARK_DOCTOR_FORCE_UNHEALTHY
env_vars.description: Test fixture: make doctor report an error finding and exit 1

side_effects.notes: Reads only the candidate, assertion and lock paths given on the command line. Score reports go to stdout; the only artifact benchmark writes itself is one append-only record per scoring run in the witness ledger (opt out with --no-witness; a ledger write failure never changes the exit code). doctor, capabilities, robot-docs and witness commands do not append to the ledger.

determinism.statement: The same candidate bytes, assertion set bytes and key columns/profile always produce a byte-identical report; raw failure cells require --explicit.

agent_rules: Use benchmark to produce quality evidence, not policy decisions.
Pass benchmark.v0 reports to assess when policy rules depend on quality_band.
Use --lock when the candidate should be tied to a prior vacuum/hash/lock pipeline.
